title: Dow Jones Futures: Stock Market Hits Highs On U.S.-Iran Deal; Dell Surges On Earnings
title_zh: 道琼斯期货：美伊协议推动股市触及高位；戴尔盈利飙升
summary: The stock market rose to fresh highs Thursday on a reported interim U.S.-Iran deal. Dell soared overnight on earnings.
summary_zh: 据报道，美国与伊朗达成临时协议，周四股市升至新高。戴尔的盈利隔夜飙升。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Pull Back After Trump Wants 'Couple Days To Think' About Iran Ceasefire Deal: ASTS, DELL, BB, SMCI In Focus
title_zh: 特朗普希望“几天时间考虑”伊朗停火协议后，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货回调：ASTS、DELL、BB、SMCI 成为焦点
summary: According to a report from Axios, the U.S. and Iran have reached a tentative deal to extend the ceasefire between the two nations by 60 days and are on track to discuss Tehran’s nuclear program.
summary_zh: 据Axios报道，美国和伊朗已达成初步协议，将两国停火期限延长60天，并有望讨论德黑兰的核计划。

title: Oil eyes weekly drop on Hormuz deal hopes; AI sends stocks to record highs
title_zh: 霍尔木兹协议希望石油价格每周下跌；人工智能推动股市创历史新高
summary: By Tom Westbrook SINGAPORE, May 29 (Reuters) - World stocks stood at record highs on Friday and oil futures eyed the steepest weekly drop for nearly two months as traders waited for details on a
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 5 月 29 日 - 世界股市周五创下历史新高，石油期货创下近两个月来最大单周跌幅，交易员正在等待有关细节。

title: Jamie Dimon spills beans on his next big JPMorgan deal
title_zh: 杰米·戴蒙 (Jamie Dimon) 透露他的下一笔摩根大通 (JPMorgan) 重大交易
summary: Every Jamie Dimon appearance gets parsed like a Federal Reserve statement. Markets move on a single sentence. Reporters strip-mine each quote for hints. That is the price of running the country's largest bank.
summary_zh: 杰米戴蒙的每一次露面都会像美联储声明一样被解析。市场因一句话而变化。记者们逐条挖掘每一条引文以寻找线索。这就是经营该国最大银行的代价。

title: Dell Stock Jumps on Multibillion-Dollar Pentagon Software Deal
title_zh: 戴尔股价因价值数十亿美元的五角大楼软件交易而上涨
summary: Dell Secures Multibillion-Dollar Pentagon Contract, Shares Surge Into Earnings
summary_zh: 戴尔获得五角大楼数十亿美元合同，股价飙升
